captions.text: Coere builds your memory from your chats and adds it to new ones while you type.
Installing opens onboarding. Cori asks which AIs you use.
Maya uses ChatGPT, Claude and Gemini.
Save starts Extract all on each of them.
Extract all reads each AI and saves every chat, with a row for each.
Every chat is saved on this computer.
Cori asks what to build memory from. Nothing goes to an AI until Maya says yes.
New chats will save by themselves, and context goes into new chats as she types.
Coere reads her chats with Claude and grows the graph as it goes.
Cori works away in the corner. She can close the page, and the build goes on.
Cori finishes the graph with his hammer.
Your memory is ready. Cori offers to show Maya around.
The tour starts at Home, with the AIs Maya uses.
Then the graph: Maya in the middle, a section for each part of her life.
The Memory page draws what Coere knows, with Maya in the middle.
A click opens a section, with its folders and memories.
Search finds a person, whose sheet starts with how to reach them.
Under it, what her chats say about Elena, each with the chat it came from.
Six days later, Maya has new chats on ChatGPT, Claude and Gemini.
When she opens an AI, Coere saves her new chats by itself.
The first time she opens an AI, Cori shows how to call him: Right Option.
A tap brings out his chat, and the card is gone for good.
Then it reads them, and the graph grows.
Six more days pass, and more chats come in.
Home counts what Coere remembers, and Recently saved leads with the newest chats.
In a fresh chat on ChatGPT, Maya asks for help with her PearX interview.
The blue line says Coere will add her prep chat, and shows the AIs it learned from.
The list shows what goes in: the chat, then her memories about PearX and what it links to.
Add chat, Add memory and Ask Cori bring in more, in her own words.
One Enter puts the chat in as a file, with her context in front of the draft, and sends.
ChatGPT starts from the work she already did.
With Voice mode on, she holds Right Option and asks Cori out loud.
She lets go. Cori answers in his chat and says it out loud.
With Browser Use on, Cori can act in her browser too.
On the Cori page she asks for an email in her own words, and Cori shows his plan.
Two people in her mail are called Sam, so he asks which one.
He writes it in his own Gmail tab, in her style. Take over and Stop are on the bar.
The draft waits in Gmail for her to send.
A bigger search is split across workers, each in a tab of its own.
Their finds merge into one table, each value with the page it came from.
In Settings, Enable Dev Tools adds Statistics to the dashboard.
It counts the tokens memory saved on her PearX send, and what building it cost.
Maya asks Cori to delete everything about Sparrowhawk, her old side project.
Cori counts what it found. Review shows all of it first.
The graph lights the project and its memories, and the sheet says what goes.
Then Coere checks that nothing about it is left.
Coere v2: a memory built from your chats, added as you type, and an app that acts on it.
